title: Which One? N1 Look-alikes
description: Contrast practice: そばから / なり, をものともせず / をよそに, にたえる / に足りない, を機に / を皮切りに, といえども / たところで.

points.title: そばから vs なり
points.summary: そばから = again and again, as fast as A, B undoes it. なり = one time: as soon as A, the same person did B.
points.body:
- 干す**そばから**雨が降ってくる (every time).
- 受話器を置く**なり**泣き崩れた (once).
examples: {受話器|じゅわき}を{置|お}くなり、{彼女|かのじょ}は{泣|な}き{崩|くず}れた。
As soon as she put the phone down, she broke down in tears.

points.title: をものともせず vs をよそに
points.summary: をものともせず = undaunted by a hardship or obstacle (praise). をよそに = ignoring other people's worries or objections.
points.body:
- けが**をものともせず**走り抜いた.
- 家族の心配**をよそに**山に登った.
examples: {家族|かぞく}の{心配|しんぱい}をよそに、{彼|かれ}は{冬山|ふゆやま}に{登|のぼ}った。
Ignoring his family's worries, he climbed the mountain in winter.

points.title: にたえる vs に足りない
points.summary: 鑑賞にたえる = good enough to be appreciated. 取るに足りない = too trivial to bother with.
points.body:
- 鑑賞**にたえる**水準.
- 取る**に足りない**問題.
examples: {取|と}るに{足|た}りない{問題|もんだい}だ。

points.title: を機に vs を皮切りに
points.summary: を機に = a turning point that prompts a change. を皮切りに = the first of a series.
points.body:
- 結婚**を機に**仕事を辞めた.
- 大阪**を皮切りに**全国に店を広げた.
examples: {大阪|おおさか}を{皮切|かわき}りに、{全国|ぜんこく}に{店|みせ}を{広|ひろ}げた。
Starting in Osaka, they opened shops all over the country.

points.title: といえども vs たところで
points.summary: Noun + といえども = even (someone you'd expect better from). た-form + ところで = even if you do it, it's pointless.
points.body:
- 名医**といえども**治せない.
- 頼んだ**ところで**聞いてくれない.
examples: いくら{頼|たの}んだところで、{彼|かれ}は{聞|き}いてくれないだろう。
However much you ask, he won't listen.

questions.prompt: いつも{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す（　）、{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ってくる。
notes: が最後 = 'once …, no going back'.
とみるや = 'on judging that' — a one-off reaction.
なり is for a one-off event by the same person.
questions.translation: Every time I hang the washing out, it starts raining.

questions.prompt: {受話器|じゅわき}を{置|お}く（　）、{彼女|かのじょ}は{泣|な}き{崩|くず}れた。
notes: ばかりに = 'just because'.
そばから is for repeated cycles.
がてら = 'while also'.
questions.translation: As soon as she put the phone down, she broke down in tears.

questions.prompt: {足|あし}のけが（　）、{彼|かれ}は{決勝|けっしょう}に{出場|しゅつじょう}した。
questions.explanation: Undaunted by a hardship: **をものともせず**.
notes: をいいことに = 'taking (bad) advantage of'.
をおいて = 'apart from'.
をよそに is for other people's worries, not your own injury.
questions.translation: Despite his injured leg, he competed in the final.

questions.prompt: {家族|かぞく}の{心配|しんぱい}（　）、{彼|かれ}は{冬山|ふゆやま}に{登|のぼ}った。
notes: をおいて = 'apart from'.
をものともせず is for hardships and dangers — here it's the family's worry.
をいいことに = 'taking advantage of'.
questions.translation: Ignoring his family's worries, he climbed the mountain in winter.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}の{作品|さくひん}は、プロの{鑑賞|かんしょう}（　）{水準|すいじゅん}に{達|たっ}している。
notes: 鑑賞に足りない would contradict 'has reached a professional level'.
にあたらない = 'no need to'.
には及ばない = 'no need / not a match'.
questions.translation: His work has reached a level worth a professional's appreciation.

questions.prompt: {取|と}る（　）{問題|もんだい}だから、{気|き}にしなくていい。
notes: に難くない = 'easy to (imagine)'.
取るに値する isn't the idiom.
取るにたえる isn't the idiom.
questions.translation: It's a trivial problem — no need to worry about it.

questions.prompt: {結婚|けっこん}（　）、{彼女|かのじょ}は{仕事|しごと}を{辞|や}めた。
notes: を限りに takes a time noun (今日を限りに).
を皮切りに = the first of a series.
を経て = 'via / after going through'.
questions.translation: She quit her job when she got married.

questions.prompt: {大阪|おおさか}（　）、{全国|ぜんこく}に{店|みせ}を{広|ひろ}げた。
questions.explanation: First of a series: **を皮切りに**.
notes: を機に = a turning point that prompts a change, not the first of many.
を限りに = 'as of (the end)'.
をよそに = 'ignoring'.
questions.translation: Starting in Osaka, they opened shops all over the country.

questions.prompt: {名医|めいい}（　）、この{病気|びょうき}は{治|なお}せない。
notes: とあれば = 'if it's for'.
たところで follows a verb (た-form).
とあって = 'because (special situation)'.
questions.translation: Even a great doctor can't cure this illness.

questions.prompt: いくら{頼|たの}んだ（　）、{彼|かれ}は{聞|き}いてくれないだろう。
notes: といえども follows a noun.
とあって = 'because (special situation)'.
とあれば = 'if it's for'.
questions.translation: However much you ask, he won't listen.
